value.rationale: Retraction rank is a natural invariant of split quotient structure in nonassociative algebras. The theorem gives the complete family and image types in all dimensions and arbitrary characteristic (under a canonical nondegeneracy condition), plus exact odd-field multiplicities. Orthogonal-space type and square-generator isotropy independently alter coefficients, as explicitly demonstrated on F_3 and F_5; this information is not given by a bare classification of evolution-algebra structures. The exact rank counts support natural later questions about endomorphism semigroups and split quotients.
